headline: Terms & Conditions
content:
Last updated: June 2026

1. Booking & Payment

Full payment is required at the time of booking unless otherwise agreed. Prices are in Malaysian Ringgit (MYR) and include all food and guide services.

2. Cancellation Policy

  • Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the tour
  • Cancellations within 24 hours: 50% charge
  • No-show: full charge
  • We reserve the right to cancel tours due to extreme weather - full refund offered

3. Dietary Requirements

We accommodate vegetarian, vegan, halal, and common allergies. Please inform us at least 48 hours before the tour of any specific dietary needs.

4. Health & Safety

Participants should be in reasonable health for light walking (approximately 2km). Please inform us of any medical conditions that may affect your participation.

5. Photography

We may take photos during tours for marketing purposes. Let us know if you prefer not to be photographed.

6. Liability

Simply Enak is not liable for loss, injury, or damage to personal property during tours. Participants join at their own risk.

7. Changes to Terms

We reserve the right to update these terms. Continued booking after changes constitutes acceptance.

8. Contact

For questions about these terms, contact booking@simplyenak.com.

headline: Privacy Policy
content:
Last updated: June 2026

1. Introduction

Simply Enak Food Experiences ("we", "our", "us") respects your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data.

2. Data We Collect

  • Booking information: Name, email, phone number, dietary requirements, group size
  • Communication data: WhatsApp messages, email correspondence
  • Website usage: Anonymous analytics via Google Analytics (page views, session duration)

3. How We Use Your Data

  • To process and confirm tour bookings
  • To communicate tour details and meeting points
  • To accommodate dietary restrictions and special requests
  • To improve our website and services
  • To respond to inquiries

4. Data Sharing

We do not sell your personal data. We may share necessary information with:

  • Tour guides (only your name and dietary needs)
  • Payment processors (for booking transactions)
  • Legal authorities if required by law

5. Data Retention

We retain booking data for 3 years after your tour. Marketing data is retained until you opt out.

6. Your Rights

You have the right to:

  • Access your personal data
  • Request correction or deletion
  • Withdraw consent for marketing
  • Lodge a complaint with your local data authority

7. Contact

For privacy inquiries, contact us at booking@simplyenak.com or via WhatsApp at +60 17 287 8929.
